## Description

## Type of change

<!-- Check the type that matches your Conventional Commit type. -->

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — adding or fixing tests
- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `chore` — build process, tooling, or dependency changes
- [ ] Breaking change (`!` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`)

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `gofmt` / `go fmt ./...` applied
- [ ] `golangci-lint run` passes
- [ ] `make build` passes (runs the unit tests)
- [ ] `make cover` passes
- [ ] `go mod tidy` leaves `go.mod` and `go.sum` unchanged
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] Documentation updated where relevant (README / CONTRIBUTING)
